steps.note: Keyboard focus traversal (quadraui#918): Tab cycles focus across the two panes of the tab_group_demo's TabGroup, wrapping at the last pane back to the first — unlike ShellView's own activity-bar cursor, which saturates at the ends (per compose/app_shell.rs). This scenario proves the wrapping end to end through a real AppLogic. The fixture starts with pane 0 already focused (TabGroupDemo::new focuses pane 0).
A second Tab wraps back to pane 0 rather than saturating or going out of range — the wrap, not just the cycle, is what this scenario is for.
